tools.name: md_status
tools.description: Check MarkItDown MCP: workdir, outdir, package-local styles (CSS/JS Copy toolbar), and optional Sublime path.

tools.name: md_styles
tools.description: Report package-local style/JS paths (markitdown-mcp/styles/rts-markdown-common.css + rts-markdown-copy.js) and whether they exist.

tools.name: md_install_styles
tools.description: Wire Sublime Text MarkdownPreview to this package styles/ folder (CSS + Copy JS). Writes/updates Packages/User/MarkdownPreview.sublime-settings.

force.description: If true, overwrite existing css/js entries in MarkdownPreview settings (default true).

tools.name: md_convert
tools.description: Convert plain text content or a file (.txt/.json/.csv/.html/.md and more) into properly formatted Wiki-ready Markdown. Writes a .md file under MARKITDOWN_OUTDIR (or outputPath). Output is pure Markdown so Sublime MarkdownPreview can use this package styles/ CSS + Copy Markdown / Copy Formatted buttons.

content.description: Raw text / note content to convert (when not using inputPath).

inputPath.description: Path to a source file (.txt, .json, .csv, .html, .md, …). Absolute or relative to MARKITDOWN_WORKDIR.

outputPath.description: Optional output .md path. Absolute or relative to MARKITDOWN_OUTDIR. Default: derived from title or input file name.

title.description: Optional document title (H1). Auto-detected from banners/filename when omitted.

sourceLabel.description: Optional source label stored in a blockquote (e.g. original .txt name).

openInSublime.description: If true, open the generated .md in Sublime Text so Ctrl+Shift+M preview uses shared styles + Copy toolbar.

overwrite.description: If false, refuse to overwrite an existing output file (default true).

tools.name: md_convert_batch
tools.description: Convert all matching files in a folder (default *.txt) to Markdown. Same formatting rules as md_convert.

folder.description: Folder to scan (absolute or relative to MARKITDOWN_WORKDIR).

writeIndex.description: If true, write/update 00-Converted-Index.md in the folder.

tools.name: md_format
tools.description: Normalize an existing .md file (fence spacing, blank lines around tables/headings) without removing content. Keeps Wiki + Sublime preview consistency.

inPlace.description: If true (default), overwrite the same file; otherwise write beside it as *.formatted.md.

tools.name: md_preview
tools.description: Open a Markdown file in Sublime Text. Preview with Ctrl+Shift+M uses this package styles/ CSS + Copy Markdown / Copy Formatted.

path.description: Path to a .md file (absolute or relative to MARKITDOWN_OUTDIR / WORKDIR).
